[review by yagopv]
@akshay-ap this PR launch a `NoRelayerDefinedError` when no relayer is defined. This is against the:

> Stage 1 — current behaviour (default / kill switch): no fee collected; Gelato relay not mandatory (non-Gelato/EOA flow allowed). Reverting to this stage is the kill switch / security fallback.

Defined in https://linear.app/safe-global/issue/PLA-1560/backend-per-chain-gtf-stage-flag-3-stages-incl-kill-switch

Or am I missing something? I thought that when the relayer is not defined, we default to the current production interface where connected wallets pay

src/modules/fees/routes/fees.service.ts:56
Is this correct instead simply retrieving the configured relayer and that's it? I believe this is not true for Phase 3, as we will have a new specific GTF relayer (I guess)

Additionally, the error seems strange to me: "Pay with Safe not available for this chain." Technically, we will be able to "Pay with Safe" in Phase 3, right?  More accurate would be something like "You haven't configured a relayer for this chain that uses the Fee Service."
